title: Clean completion of a halting computation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $c_0$ be a configuration on input $x$, and let $y$ be a Boolean word. If after $T$ steps from $c_0$ the machine is halted and its output is $y$, then there is a time $\tau \le 3T+|x|+|y|+8$ at which the clean wrapper, started from the captured logged configuration of $c_0$ with empty captured word and output, reaches the administrative configuration with the source work fields restored to those of $c_0$, the retained word $y$, halted control, input head at position $1$, capture head at position $0$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
the machine is halted after $T$ steps from $c_0$
replaced:
If a machine $M$ halts within $T$ steps from configuration $c_0$ on input $x$ with
output $y$, then within $3T + |x| + |y| + 8$ steps the clean wrapper of $M$,
started at the captured logged start of $c_0$, halts in the administrative
configuration with $c_0$'s work fields restored, all histories blank, $y$
retained on the last tape, the input head at cell one, the capture head at zero,
and no physical output.
